turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on weather words?
turns.tutor:
Worked example: "Wear sunglasses. It is ___ now." Step 1: the clue is sunglasses. Step 2: we wear them when the sun shines. So: It is sunny now.
Rule: look for the clue, think what the sky is like, then pick that weather word.
Right: Wear a coat. It is cold outside. Wrong: Wear a coat. It is hot outside.
Your turn. Write the missing word:
Complete: "Take an umbrella. It is ___ today."
